prompts.text: Use the browse tools (not bash). Navigate to http://fixture:8080/index.html, take a snapshot, fill the form (Full name: Ada Lovelace, Email: ada@example.com, Plan: Pro, accept the terms), click Create account, then take a screenshot and reply with the exact confirmation text shown under the form.
Use the browse tools. Navigate to https://example.com in a new tab, take a snapshot and reply with the page's main heading only.

tool_calls.code: const r = await search({namespace: "browse", limit: 50}); return r.items.map(i => i.path + " :: " + i.description).join("\n");
tool_calls.result:
tools.browse.click :: Click an element (or x/y in page CSS pixels). Waits until it is visible, enabled and not moving, scrolls it into view and checks nothing covers it: a covered target fails fast naming the element on top (dismiss it, or pass force). Returns JSON: clicked, url, and what changed: navigated/title, urlChanged, dialog (the page is paused until you call dialog), newTabs, challenge/warning.
tools.browse.console :: Opt-in capture of a tab's own console messages and uncaught errors. Off by default because it enables the CDP Runtime domain, which pages (and bot checks) can detect; stop it when done. Includes out-of-process iframes and workers, and browser log entries such as CSP vi

tool_calls.code: const nav = await tools.browse.navigate({url: "http://fixture:8080/index.html"}); const snap = await tools.browse.snapshot({tab: nav.tab}); return JSON.stringify({nav, snap}, null, 2);
